_note: Simplified 3D reconstruction for orientation. Major structures follow commonly cited dimensions (Josephus, the Mishnah, archaeology) and are generalized; houses are illustrative only. The second wall (course debated) and the third wall (after the Gospel events) are not shown. Added: the Nicanor Gate, the warning barrier, the Huldah Gates and southern steps, Robinson's and Wilson's Arches and the stepped street, from Josephus, the Mishnah and excavation reports (tools/add-temple-detail.py); they sit on the model's generalized walls at their reported positions.
